CITY OF LA VERNE
  DEVELOPMENT REVIEW COMMITTEE
  ACTION MINUTES

Eric Scherer, Chair  City Hall
Cody Howing, City Engineer  3660 “D” Street
Richard Martinez, Public Works  La Verne, CA 91750
  (909) 596-8706
  www.cityoflaverne.org

  Tuesday, May 2, 2023 – 9:00 a.m.
  City Hall Large Conference Room
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Development Review Committee meetings are welcomed
and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Development Review Committee with valuable
information. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st Tuesday of every month. In compliance with the American
Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a modification or accommodation in order to
participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the
meeting.

The Large Conference Room will be open to the public at 9:00 a.m. Materials related to an item on this agenda,
submitted to the Development Review Committee after distribution of the agenda packet, are available for
public inspection at the meeting or in the Community Development Department during normal business hours.

  1. CALL TO ORDER

  The meeting was called to order at 9:00 a.m.

  Voting members present: Eric Scherer, Cody Howing, and Richard Martinez

  Others present: Assistant Planner Gabriel Rivera, Assistant Planner Parker
  Stringfellow, and Principal Planner Candice Bowcock

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT

  This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the Development Review
  Committee on items not listed in any other place on this agenda.
 Development Review Committee Action Minutes - May 2, 2023
Page 2

  California Law does not allow the Development Review Committee to take action in
  response to your statements at this meeting. Your concerns may be referred to
  staff or set for hearing at a later date.

  None

  3. APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES – January 10, 2023

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Mr. Martinez to approve the minutes
  of the January 10, 2023 meeting. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  4. PROJECT REVIEWS

  Note: Due to time constraints, discussion on these items will be limited to 30
  minutes each.

  A.  PROJECT:  VARIANCE FOR A GARAGE ADDITION IN THE
  FRONT SETBACK
  CASE NO.:  15-23VAR & 16-23PPR
  ADDRESS:  1122 SANDHURST LANE
  Project Planner:  Gabriel Rivera

  Deposit Project #: 1392
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: The architect Erik Peterson and property owners Dax and
  Kari Pascua was present.

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Mr. Martinez to recommend
  approval with added conditions regarding HOA approval. Motion carried by a
  3-0 vote.

  B.  PROJECT:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR CREATIVE
  CULTIVATION STUDIO
  CASE NO.:  43-23CUP
  ADDRESS:  2232 D STREET, SUITE 201
  Project Planner:  Parker Stringfellow

  Deposit Project #: 1395
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: The applicant Shannon Saravia was present.

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Mr. Martinez to recommend
  approval with revisions to the hours of operation. Motion carried by a 3-0
  vote.

  2
 Development Review Committee Agenda- May 2, 2023
Page 3
  C.  PROJECT:  PUBLIC ART
  CASE NO.:  38-23PPR
  ADDRESS:  2109 WHITE AVENUE
  Project Planner:  Candice Bowcock

  Deposit Project #: 1326
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: The applicant was not present. Mr. Scherer recused himself due to
  a conflict of interest.

  It was moved by Mr. Martinez and seconded by Mr. Howing to approve with
  an added condition for third party public appraiser. Motion carried by a 2-0
  vote.

  D.  PROJECT:  NEW INDUSTRIAL BUILDING AND LOT LINE
  ADJUSTMENT
  CASE NO.:  145-22PPR & 146-22LLA
  ADDRESS:  1415 PALOMARES AVENUE AND 1421 PALOMARES
  AVENUE
  Project Planner:  Candice Bowcock

  Deposit Project #: 1390
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: The applicants James M. Park and Todd Launchbagh were present.
  Mr. Scherer recused himself due to a conflict of interest.

  It was moved by Mr. Martinez and seconded by Mr. Howing to recommend
  approval with added conditions for public and private utilities. Motion carried
  by a 2-0 vote.

  5. ADJOURNMENT

  The next meeting of the Development Review Committee is scheduled to be held
  on June 6, 2023 at 9:00 a.m. at City Hall, 3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.

Proof of Posting  I declare under penalty of perjury that I am employed by the City
  of La Verne in the Planning Department; and that I posted this
  agenda in the City Hall Council Chambers on April 27, 2023.
